title: Ankhorage Supabase Infrastructure
summary: Provides a runtime-neutral Supabase platform service adapter with portable workloads and post-runtime API reconciliation.
purpose: Compose Supabase infrastructure independently of the selected runtime while keeping bootstrap secrets at the execution boundary.
responsibilities: Contribute portable Supabase service workloads to infrastructure desired state.
Reconcile Supabase-owned API resources after the selected runtime is ready.
Use the configured vault boundary for bootstrap secret material without returning resolved values.
boundaries: Does not define provider-neutral infrastructure contracts.
Does not own the concrete Kubernetes or Docker Compose runtime materialization.
Does not expose resolved bootstrap secrets in portable desired state or results.
audience: Infrastructure hosts composing Supabase as a platform service.
Operators deploying Supabase workloads through a selected provider-neutral runtime.
useCases: Add Supabase workloads to portable infrastructure intent.
Reconcile Supabase-owned API resources after runtime deployment.
Resolve bootstrap material through the vault boundary during execution.

architecture.role: A runtime-neutral infrastructure service adapter layered above a selected runtime.
invariants: Runtime-specific workload materialization remains outside the provider.
Supabase API reconciliation occurs only after runtime readiness.
Resolved bootstrap secrets never cross the execution boundary.

configuration: A selected runtime and compatible secret-vault configuration are required.
security: Resolved bootstrap secrets remain inside the execution boundary.
limitations: The package does not select or provision its underlying runtime.
